## What this tests
Whether a generated offline wheelhouse can be applied to a native `ai_runtime_task`. Submitted directly through the Jobs API from a local repo checkout; no AIR CLI is involved.

## Repro
Use the [exact Jobs payload](https://fevm-classic-stable-1fe1nl.cloud.databricks.com/editor/files/2118837658863667?o=7474653260736890) and [assertion-gated probe](https://fevm-classic-stable-1fe1nl.cloud.databricks.com/editor/files/2184668813904303?o=7474653260736890). Shape: one `GPU_1xA10`, managed `workspace-base-environments/databricks_ai_v5`, generated wheelhouse dependencies inline, zero retries, 600-second task timeout. Full receipts and rerun notes: [NOTES.md](https://fevm-classic-stable-1fe1nl.cloud.databricks.com/editor/files/2184668813904305?o=7474653260736890).

## Pass
Terminal `SUCCESS`; exact `mlflow==3.16.0`, `pydantic==2.13.5`, and `scikit-learn==1.9.1`; one visible A10; `JOBS_API_WHEELHOUSE_ENV_OK`; `VERDICT: ACCEPTED`; MLflow acceptance params.

## Observed
2026-09-22 on `f-classic`: custom Volume environment paths are rejected before launch (Jobs run `835858704824011`). The supported fully qualified managed base plus inline dependencies passed control-plane validation, but Jobs run `951241043188348` / task `1017402744436040` waited for A10 capacity and timed out after 653 seconds; MLflow run `b2cf98c236784d5097fd9a784c75f9c3` is `KILLED`. Package installation remains blocked, not failed.
